exposure: color Doppler evaluation of fetoplacental circulation
outcome: neonatal complications (including acidosis, still birth, oligohydramnios, low birth weight, fetal distress in labor)
cohort: The study included 58 patients with Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) pregnancies admitted to a Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
finding: Doppler studies of multiple vessels in the fetoplacental circulation were found to be helpful in monitoring compromised fetuses and predicting neonatal morbidity in IUGR pregnancies, potentially aiding in determining the optimal time of delivery.
